description:
A lightweight, developer-focused database management tool. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL and SQLite. Hackable with plugins. Built for speed, security, and aesthetics.


Read the v0.31.0 release post.
Bug Fixes
- ai-approval: close the approval modal when its request has expired (#1365) (a95e9df)
- ai: use the first text block of an Anthropic response (#1332) (2f2bb3c), closes #1330
- check out text files with LF line endings on every platform (#1335) (1cfa113)
- ci: verify experimental nightly AppImage layout (#1293) (e76c2f1)
- connections: show "All databases" for PostgreSQL connections too (#1282) (9e3c622), closes #1281
- connections: show the database name when one database is selected (#1344) (a162abc)
- docs: count downloads across all GitHub releases (#1321) (c465807)
- editor: open Generate SQL console on the table's database (#1363) (6c4e363)
- release: keep web UI package version in sync (#1340) (375e93a)
- scripts: write version.ts with single quotes in sync-version (#1289) (90ec2f5), closes #1247
Features
- ai: prefer MiniMax M3.1 Flash in text catalogs (#1230) (0116178)
- connection-import: import connections from HeidiSQL (#1345) (8757509)
- connection-import: import connections from MySQL Workbench (#1355) (3ac4c4b), closes #1310
- connection-import: import connections from Navicat .ncx files (#1346) (e2a91d9), closes #1312
- connections: per-connection connect timeout for PostgreSQL and MySQL (#1288) (197e022)
- data-grid: double-click a column border to fit its width (#1339) (569cde1)
- data-grid: find text in the loaded results (#1350) (e4c1eea)
- data-grid: hide and show columns in the current result (#1351) (3304a09), closes #1299 #1350 #1349
- editor: analyze editor crashes with the configured AI provider (#1369) (835b6ce), closes #1360
- editor: copy crash report and open a prefilled bug report (#1364) (201ef8e)
- editor: pin query tabs (#1354) (f7f95b8)
- explain: add a Loops column, open the plan in its own window and reorder table columns (#1368) (1590b32), closes #308
- explain: show a Loops column in the EXPLAIN table view (#1367) (aeee15a), closes #308
- explorer: pin tables and views to the top of the list (#1353) (0abd2d4)
- grid: add a transposed layout to the result grid (#1357) (de134e5), closes #561 #1351
- grid: add does not contain, starts with and ends with to Filter by this value (#1338) (fc6b6c7), closes #1296
- grid: copy rows as SQL UPDATE statements (#1349) (8d2e735)
- grid: jump to a page number from the pagination bar (#1320) (9135918), closes #1303 #1303
- history: export filtered query history as SQL (#1352) (2b977cb)
- i18n: add Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) translation (#1366) (d1fb5a7)
- i18n: add Vietnamese translation (#1329) (afd170d), closes #1313
- result-chart: follow-ups from the #1193 review (#1290) (5670929)
- saved-queries: export all queries or a folder to one .sql file (#1325) (f5f7806)
- saved-queries: keep version history for saved queries (#1356) (886e7f6)
- settings: add a NULL display setting for the data grid (#1343) (ae5b1c3)
- settings: choose how NULL is written when copying rows (#1333) (40847a2)
- sidebar: show index and foreign key details (#1326) (760fecf)
- web-ui: add Markdown and SQL INSERT to Export Selected context menu (#1317) (f986596)
- web: restyle the password login page (#1347) (1c2c53e)
- web: resume connection links after password login (#1294) (b6f8f49), closes #1275
Full comparison: v0.30.0...v0.31.0
